title: Fixed derived site comparisons used in exchange transport
statement: For the etale-to-pro-etale comparison ν and scheme morphisms, fix the five comparison isomorphisms appearing in the transport theorem, with the direct-image isomorphism of [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image]. The direct-image comparison is the rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange of the underived restriction mate, followed by its Plus-to-unbounded compatibility. The pullback comparison is the exact-derived image of the canonical underived pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], followed by the canonical identification with left-derived pullback. Source and target comparisons are their whiskered composites. These are the same five constructions previously defined in the SmoothBaseChange module; this node records their shared definition module.
